verdict.rationale: llamafile is a local LLM runtime with an HTTP server, so serving throughput is a fair axis to judge it on. However, nothing in the evidence documents continuous batching or chunked prefill. The only related item is a passing mention of 'slot' options in the server help (llamafile-docs-9), which is an adjacent control and not a documented batching or prefill capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can achieve high serving throughput via continuous batching and chunked prefill
